title: Allard's Lemma 8.5.10 in corrected form 5.10′ with Remark 5.11: bad-set and fibre-density bounds
statement: Assume MonotonicityFormula (Simon 8.3.3, frozen contract statement). Let N, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1 and Λ ≥ 1. There are δ̄ > 0 and c₀ ≥ 0 such that for all δ ∈ (0,δ̄] and ε ∈ (0,δ⁴], every U ⊆ ℝ^N with B°_3(0) ⊆ U, every n-varifold W on U with locally bounded first variation and every P ∈ G(N,n) with (‡) μ_W(B°_3(0)) ≤ Λ, ‖δW‖(B°_3(0)) < ε² and ∫_{B°_3(0)×G} t_P(S) dW(z,S) < ε² (t_P(S) the operator norm of p_S − p_P): calling y good if (1) ‖δW‖(B_ρ(y)) ≤ εμ_W(B_ρ(y)) for all ρ ∈ (0,1) and (2) ∫_{B_ρ(y)×G} t_P dW ≤ ερ^n for all ρ ∈ (0,1), (a) the set E of points of B_2(0) ∩ spt μ_W that are not good has μ_W(E) ≤ c₀ε; (b) for every x ∈ P with |x| < 1, every finite set s of good points y ∈ B_2(0) ∩ spt μ_W with p_P(y) = x and |y − p_P(y)| < ε, and every Θ : ℝ^N → [0,∞] with HasDensity n μ_W y (Θ(y)) and Θ(y) ≥ 1 for y ∈ s: Σ_{y∈s} Θ(y) ≤ (1+δ)μ_W(B_1(x))/ω_n + δ.
